features.label: Tavily connection check
features.instructions: Active signed-in community administrators can open Integration checks from the manager demo dashboard and select Test Tavily connection. It uses the server-only TAVILY_API_KEY to send one fixed public query, consuming search allowance. No bills or chat history are sent. This only verifies connectivity; conversational web research is not connected. Anonymous visitors and consumers cannot run the check. Deployment and a live provider result are separate verification steps.

features.label: Future community services
features.instructions: On the consumer dashboard select Explore future services. Browse Food delivery, Grocery delivery, Water delivery, Home maintenance, Laundry pickup and Solar-charged home battery cards, all marked Future service. The battery example explores buying a Powerwall-style battery for solar storage, subject to compatibility, sizing, installation and cost assessment; no supplier or savings are confirmed. Select Request on a card, add an optional made-up note, then Add example request. This is only a preview: no request is sent, no provider is connected and nothing can be ordered. Changes stay in the same browser tab until it closes or Reset examples is used.

features.label: Community manager service examples
features.instructions: On the community manager demo dashboard select Service requests · example. View sample consumer requests plus requests added in the consumer preview in the same tab. Select Add service example, enter a name and brief description, then Add future service. The new card appears in the consumer preview but does not launch a service. This public example is not a protected live manager workflow.

features.label: Private conversation history and recall
features.instructions: In the configured local beta, open Saved CP conversations from dashboard help, or /conversations after community login. Use New conversation, Send and save, Your history, Save title, or Delete conversation and confirm Delete permanently. Allow recall for this conversation is optional and off by default; turning it off removes vectors and queued work but retains saved messages. The embedding worker is not connected: recall does not search history yet. Setup requires the saved-chat-turn migration and server configuration; deployment remains pending. Replies are scripted preview help. Public demo and dashboard quick-help chats remain session-only.

features.label: Home
features.instructions: Open Home for the introduction and Sign up / Log in dialog.

features.label: About Community Power
features.instructions: Open About for the supplier-neutral platform purpose and planning limits.

features.label: Login and recovery
features.instructions: On Home, select Sign up / Log in, choose My community or Sandz platform, and sign in. Use Forgot password for recovery. Sandz setup is pending; public sign-up is invitation-only.

features.label: My bills and history
features.instructions: Consumers sign in and open My bills. When enabled, choose Bill images, consent, Read and save drafts, Review bill, then Confirm and add to history. House / electricity account separates histories. Uploads remain gated pending release review; all ownership is unverified.

features.label: Consumer demo
features.instructions: Use My energy or Let's look at a bill for sample arithmetic. This does not upload or save a real bill.

features.label: Community board demo
features.instructions: Open the consumer demo, select Community board in the sidebar (Open menu on mobile), write Your demo note and select Post demo note. Notes reset on reload; persistence, replies, reporting and moderation are planned.

features.label: Community-admin demo
features.instructions: Use Members and Import consumers or Invite your community. Only synthetic .example addresses are accepted. Preview rows then Stage demo invitations; no invitations are emailed. Real rosters and invitation dispatch are planned.

features.label: Sandz demo
features.instructions: Explore Communities and the AI settings explanation. These are demonstration controls, not live administration or a key-entry form. Never paste credentials into CP.

features.label: Preview help
features.instructions: Open the first-look guide. CP selects public scripted answers from this draft preview guide; it does not read private bill records or execute account actions.

features.label: Account authority review
features.instructions: Independent ownership review is planned. Current name/account/address consistency checks and consumer confirmation do not establish ownership or permission to switch service.

features.label: Export, deletion and consent management
features.instructions: Self-service export, deletion requests and versioned consent management are planned. There is no supported settings page for them yet.

features.label: Offers and benefits
features.instructions: Reviewed offers, eligibility, comparisons and referral tracking need implementation and feasibility evidence. No current savings or household eligibility guarantee exists.

features.label: Optional upgrades
features.instructions: Useful free consumer features remain the baseline. Optional upgrades and billing are planned; no paid checkout is available.

features.label: Support and moderation
features.instructions: Support cases, assigned evidence reviewers and moderation controls are planned. No in-app case submission or automatic staff access to private bills exists.

features.label: Installation and offline use
features.instructions: A web manifest exists. Full PWA installation verification and offline support are not complete; do not rely on offline bill access.
